description: This file defines the final immutable class ClusterRoleStatus which encapsulates the status of a specific Akka cluster role. It includes methods for creating instances, getters for state data, and functionalities for JSON serialization, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: ClusterRoleStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of an Akka cluster role, including reachable and unreachable members, and the leader address.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new immutable instance of ClusterRoleStatus with specified role, reachable and unreachable members, and leader.

methods.name: getReachable
methods.description: Returns the set of reachable members.

methods.name: getUnreachable
methods.description: Returns the set of unreachable members.

methods.name: getLeader
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the leader address if present.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object into JSON format, including reachable and unreachable members and leader info.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this instance and another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on role, reachable, unreachable, and leader fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
